versos.hebraico: זֶ֣ה סֵ֔פֶר תּוֹלְדֹ֖ת אָדָ֑ם בְּי֗וֹם בְּרֹ֤א אֱלֹהִים֙ אָדָ֔ם בִּדְמ֥וּת אֱלֹהִ֖ים עָשָׂ֥ה אֹתֽוֹ׃

controles.web: This is the book of the generations of Adam. In the day that God created man, he made him in God’s likeness.
controles.kjv: This is the book of the generations of Adam. In the day that God created man, in the likeness of God made he him;
controles.livre: Este é o livro das gerações de Adão. No dia em que criou Deus ao ser humano, à semelhança de Deus o fez;

versos.hebraico: זָכָ֥ר וּנְקֵבָ֖ה בְּרָאָ֑ם וַיְבָ֣רֶךְ אֹתָ֗ם וַיִּקְרָ֤א אֶת־שְׁמָם֙ אָדָ֔ם בְּי֖וֹם הִבָּֽרְאָֽם׃ס

controles.web: He created them male and female, and blessed them. On the day they were created, he named them “Adam”.
controles.kjv: Male and female created he them; and blessed them, and called their name Adam, in the day when they were created.
controles.livre: Macho e fêmea os criou; e os abençoou, e chamou o nome deles Adão, no dia em que foram criados.

versos.hebraico: וַֽיְחִ֣י אָדָ֗ם שְׁלֹשִׁ֤ים וּמְאַת֙ שָׁנָ֔ה וַיּ֥וֹלֶד בִּדְמוּת֖וֹ כְּצַלְמ֑וֹ וַיִּקְרָ֥א אֶת־שְׁמ֖וֹ שֵֽׁת׃

controles.web: Adam lived one hundred thirty years, and became the father of a son in his own likeness, after his image, and named him Seth.
controles.kjv: And Adam lived an hundred and thirty years, and begat a son in his own likeness, after his image; and called his name Seth:
controles.livre: E viveu Adão cento e trinta anos, e gerou um filho à sua semelhança, conforme sua imagem, e chamou seu nome Sete.

versos.hebraico: וַיִּֽהְי֣וּ יְמֵי־אָדָ֗ם אַֽחֲרֵי֙ הוֹלִיד֣וֹ אֶת־שֵׁ֔ת שְׁמֹנֶ֥ה מֵאֹ֖ת שָׁנָ֑ה וַיּ֥וֹלֶד בָּנִ֖ים וּבָנֽוֹת׃

controles.web: The days of Adam after he became the father of Seth were eight hundred years, and he became the father of other sons and daughters.
controles.kjv: And the days of Adam after he had begotten Seth were eight hundred years: and he begat sons and daughters:
controles.livre: E foram os dias de Adão, depois que gerou a Sete, oitocentos anos: e gerou filhos e filhas.

versos.hebraico: וַיִּֽהְי֞וּ כָּל־יְמֵ֤י אָדָם֙ אֲשֶׁר־חַ֔י תְּשַׁ֤ע מֵאוֹת֙ שָׁנָ֔ה וּשְׁלֹשִׁ֖ים שָׁנָ֑ה וַיָּמֹֽת׃ס

controles.web: All the days that Adam lived were nine hundred thirty years, then he died.
controles.kjv: And all the days that Adam lived were nine hundred and thirty years: and he died.
controles.livre: E foram todos os dias que viveu Adão novecentos e trinta anos, e morreu.

versos.hebraico: וַֽיְחִי־שֵׁ֕ת חָמֵ֥שׁ שָׁנִ֖ים וּמְאַ֣ת שָׁנָ֑ה וַיּ֖וֹלֶד אֶת־אֱנֽוֹשׁ׃

controles.web: Seth lived one hundred five years, then became the father of Enosh.
controles.kjv: And Seth lived an hundred and five years, and begat Enos:
controles.livre: E viveu Sete cento e cinco anos, e gerou a Enos.

versos.hebraico: וַֽיְחִי־שֵׁ֗ת אַֽחֲרֵי֙ הוֹלִיד֣וֹ אֶת־אֱנ֔וֹשׁ שֶׁ֣בַע שָׁנִ֔ים וּשְׁמֹנֶ֥ה מֵא֖וֹת שָׁנָ֑ה וַיּ֥וֹלֶד בָּנִ֖ים וּבָנֽוֹת׃

controles.web: Seth lived after he became the father of Enosh eight hundred seven years, and became the father of other sons and daughters.
controles.kjv: And Seth lived after he begat Enos eight hundred and seven years, and begat sons and daughters:
controles.livre: E viveu Sete, depois que gerou a Enos, oitocentos e sete anos: e gerou filhos e filhas.

versos.hebraico: וַיִּֽהְיוּ֙ כָּל־יְמֵי־שֵׁ֔ת שְׁתֵּ֤ים עֶשְׂרֵה֙ שָׁנָ֔ה וּתְשַׁ֥ע מֵא֖וֹת שָׁנָ֑ה וַיָּמֹֽת׃ס

controles.web: All the days of Seth were nine hundred twelve years, then he died.
controles.kjv: And all the days of Seth were nine hundred and twelve years: and he died.
controles.livre: E foram todos os dias de Sete novecentos e doze anos; e morreu.

versos.hebraico: וַֽיְחִ֥י אֱנ֖וֹשׁ תִּשְׁעִ֣ים שָׁנָ֑ה וַיּ֖וֹלֶד אֶת־קֵינָֽן׃

controles.web: Enosh lived ninety years, and became the father of Kenan.
controles.kjv: And Enos lived ninety years, and begat Cainan:
controles.livre: E viveu Enos noventa anos, e gerou a Cainã.

versos.hebraico: וַֽיְחִ֣י אֱנ֗וֹשׁ אַֽחֲרֵי֙ הוֹלִיד֣וֹ אֶת־קֵינָ֔ן חֲמֵ֤שׁ עֶשְׂרֵה֙ שָׁנָ֔ה וּשְׁמֹנֶ֥ה מֵא֖וֹת שָׁנָ֑ה וַיּ֥וֹלֶד בָּנִ֖ים וּבָנֽוֹת׃

controles.web: Enosh lived after he became the father of Kenan, eight hundred fifteen years, and became the father of other sons and daughters.
controles.kjv: And Enos lived after he begat Cainan eight hundred and fifteen years, and begat sons and daughters:
controles.livre: E viveu Enos depois que gerou a Cainã, oitocentos e quinze anos: e gerou filhos e filhas.

versos.hebraico: וַיִּֽהְיוּ֙ כָּל־יְמֵ֣י אֱנ֔וֹשׁ חָמֵ֣שׁ שָׁנִ֔ים וּתְשַׁ֥ע מֵא֖וֹת שָׁנָ֑ה וַיָּמֹֽת׃ס

controles.web: All the days of Enosh were nine hundred five years, then he died.
controles.kjv: And all the days of Enos were nine hundred and five years: and he died.
controles.livre: E foram todos os dias de Enos novecentos e cinco anos; e morreu.

versos.hebraico: וַֽיְחִ֥י קֵינָ֖ן שִׁבְעִ֣ים שָׁנָ֑ה וַיּ֖וֹלֶד אֶת־מַֽהֲלַלְאֵֽל׃

controles.web: Kenan lived seventy years, then became the father of Mahalalel.
controles.kjv: And Cainan lived seventy years, and begat Mahalaleel:
controles.livre: E viveu Cainã setenta anos, e gerou a Maalalel.

versos.hebraico: וַיְחִ֣י קֵינָ֗ן אַחֲרֵי֙ הוֹלִיד֣וֹ אֶת־מַֽהֲלַלְאֵ֔ל אַרְבָּעִ֣ים שָׁנָ֔ה וּשְׁמֹנֶ֥ה מֵא֖וֹת שָׁנָ֑ה וַיּ֥וֹלֶד בָּנִ֖ים וּבָנֽוֹת׃

controles.web: Kenan lived after he became the father of Mahalalel eight hundred forty years, and became the father of other sons and daughters
controles.kjv: And Cainan lived after he begat Mahalaleel eight hundred and forty years, and begat sons and daughters:
controles.livre: E viveu Cainã, depois que gerou a Maalalel, oitocentos e quarenta anos: e gerou filhos e filhas.

versos.hebraico: וַיִּֽהְיוּ֙ כָּל־יְמֵ֣י קֵינָ֔ן עֶ֣שֶׂר שָׁנִ֔ים וּתְשַׁ֥ע מֵא֖וֹת שָׁנָ֑ה וַיָּמֹֽת׃ס

controles.web: and all the days of Kenan were nine hundred ten years, then he died.
controles.kjv: And all the days of Cainan were nine hundred and ten years: and he died.
controles.livre: E foram todos os dias de Cainã novecentos e dez anos; e morreu.

versos.hebraico: וַֽיְחִ֣י מַֽהֲלַלְאֵ֔ל חָמֵ֥שׁ שָׁנִ֖ים וְשִׁשִּׁ֣ים שָׁנָ֑ה וַיּ֖וֹלֶד אֶת־יָֽרֶד׃

controles.web: Mahalalel lived sixty-five years, then became the father of Jared.
controles.kjv: And Mahalaleel lived sixty and five years, and begat Jared:
controles.livre: E viveu Maalalel sessenta e cinco anos, e gerou a Jarede.

versos.hebraico: וַֽיְחִ֣י מַֽהֲלַלְאֵ֗ל אַֽחֲרֵי֙ הוֹלִיד֣וֹ אֶת־יֶ֔רֶד שְׁלֹשִׁ֣ים שָׁנָ֔ה וּשְׁמֹנֶ֥ה מֵא֖וֹת שָׁנָ֑ה וַיּ֥וֹלֶד בָּנִ֖ים וּבָנֽוֹת׃

controles.web: Mahalalel lived after he became the father of Jared eight hundred thirty years, and became the father of other sons and daughters.
controles.kjv: And Mahalaleel lived after he begat Jared eight hundred and thirty years, and begat sons and daughters:
controles.livre: E viveu Maalalel, depois que gerou a Jarede, oitocentos e trinta anos: e gerou filhos e filhas.

versos.hebraico: וַיִּהְיוּ֙ כָּל־יְמֵ֣י מַהֲלַלְאֵ֔ל חָמֵ֤שׁ וְתִשְׁעִים֙ שָׁנָ֔ה וּשְׁמֹנֶ֥ה מֵא֖וֹת שָׁנָ֑ה וַיָּמֹֽת׃ס

controles.web: All the days of Mahalalel were eight hundred ninety-five years, then he died.
controles.kjv: And all the days of Mahalaleel were eight hundred ninety and five years: and he died.
controles.livre: E foram todos os dias de Maalalel oitocentos noventa e cinco anos; e morreu.

versos.hebraico: וַֽיְחִי־יֶ֕רֶד שְׁתַּ֧יִם וְשִׁשִּׁ֛ים שָׁנָ֖ה וּמְאַ֣ת שָׁנָ֑ה וַיּ֖וֹלֶד אֶת־חֲנֽוֹךְ׃

controles.web: Jared lived one hundred sixty-two years, then became the father of Enoch.
controles.kjv: And Jared lived an hundred sixty and two years, and he begat Enoch:
controles.livre: E viveu Jarede cento e sessenta e dois anos, e gerou a Enoque.

versos.hebraico: וַֽיְחִי־יֶ֗רֶד אַֽחֲרֵי֙ הוֹלִיד֣וֹ אֶת־חֲנ֔וֹךְ שְׁמֹנֶ֥ה מֵא֖וֹת שָׁנָ֑ה וַיּ֥וֹלֶד בָּנִ֖ים וּבָנֽוֹת׃

controles.web: Jared lived after he became the father of Enoch eight hundred years, and became the father of other sons and daughters.
controles.kjv: And Jared lived after he begat Enoch eight hundred years, and begat sons and daughters:
controles.livre: E viveu Jarede, depois que gerou a Enoque, oitocentos anos: e gerou filhos e filhas.

versos.hebraico: וַיִּֽהְיוּ֙ כָּל־יְמֵי־יֶ֔רֶד שְׁתַּ֤יִם וְשִׁשִּׁים֙ שָׁנָ֔ה וּתְשַׁ֥ע מֵא֖וֹת שָׁנָ֑ה וַיָּמֹֽת׃פ

controles.web: All the days of Jared were nine hundred sixty-two years, then he died.
controles.kjv: And all the days of Jared were nine hundred sixty and two years: and he died.
controles.livre: E foram todos os dias de Jarede novecentos e sessenta e dois anos; e morreu.

versos.hebraico: וַֽיְחִ֣י חֲנ֔וֹךְ חָמֵ֥שׁ וְשִׁשִּׁ֖ים שָׁנָ֑ה וַיּ֖וֹלֶד אֶת־מְתוּשָֽׁלַח׃

controles.web: Enoch lived sixty-five years, then became the father of Methuselah.
controles.kjv: And Enoch lived sixty and five years, and begat Methuselah:
controles.livre: E viveu Enoque sessenta e cinco anos, e gerou a Matusalém.

versos.hebraico: וַיִּתְהַלֵּ֨ךְ חֲנ֜וֹךְ אֶת־הָֽאֱלֹהִ֗ים אַֽחֲרֵי֙ הוֹלִיד֣וֹ אֶת־מְתוּשֶׁ֔לַח שְׁלֹ֥שׁ מֵא֖וֹת שָׁנָ֑ה וַיּ֥וֹלֶד בָּנִ֖ים וּבָנֽוֹת׃

controles.web: After Methuselah’s birth, Enoch walked with God for three hundred years, and became the father of more sons and daughters.
controles.kjv: And Enoch walked with God after he begat Methuselah three hundred years, and begat sons and daughters:
controles.livre: E caminhou Enoque com Deus, depois que gerou a Matusalém, trezentos anos: e gerou filhos e filhas.

versos.hebraico: וַיְהִ֖י כָּל־יְמֵ֣י חֲנ֑וֹךְ חָמֵ֤שׁ וְשִׁשִּׁים֙ שָׁנָ֔ה וּשְׁלֹ֥שׁ מֵא֖וֹת שָׁנָֽה׃

controles.web: All the days of Enoch were three hundred sixty-five years.
controles.kjv: And all the days of Enoch were three hundred sixty and five years:
controles.livre: E foram todos os dias de Enoque trezentos sessenta e cinco anos.

versos.hebraico: וַיִּתְהַלֵּ֥ךְ חֲנ֖וֹךְ אֶת־הָֽאֱלֹהִ֑ים וְאֵינֶ֕נּוּ כִּֽי־לָקַ֥ח אֹת֖וֹ אֱלֹהִֽים׃פ

controles.web: Enoch walked with God, and he was not found, for God took him.
controles.kjv: And Enoch walked with God: and he was not; for God took him.
controles.livre: Caminhou, pois, Enoque com Deus, e desapareceu, porque Deus o levou.

versos.hebraico: וַיְחִ֣י מְתוּשֶׁ֔לַח שֶׁ֧בַע וּשְׁמֹנִ֛ים שָׁנָ֖ה וּמְאַ֣ת שָׁנָ֑ה וַיּ֖וֹלֶד אֶת־לָֽמֶךְ׃

controles.web: Methuselah lived one hundred eighty-seven years, then became the father of Lamech.
controles.kjv: And Methuselah lived an hundred eighty and seven years, and begat Lamech:
controles.livre: E viveu Matusalém cento e oitenta e sete anos, e gerou a Lameque.

versos.hebraico: וַֽיְחִ֣י מְתוּשֶׁ֗לַח אַֽחֲרֵי֙ הוֹלִיד֣וֹ אֶת־לֶ֔מֶךְ שְׁתַּ֤יִם וּשְׁמוֹנִים֙ שָׁנָ֔ה וּשְׁבַ֥ע מֵא֖וֹת שָׁנָ֑ה וַיּ֥וֹלֶד בָּנִ֖ים וּבָנֽוֹת׃

controles.web: Methuselah lived after he became the father of Lamech seven hundred eighty-two years, and became the father of other sons and daughters.
controles.kjv: And Methuselah lived after he begat Lamech seven hundred eighty and two years, and begat sons and daughters:
controles.livre: E viveu Matusalém, depois que gerou a Lameque, setecentos e oitenta e dois anos: e gerou filhos e filhas.

versos.hebraico: וַיִּהְיוּ֙ כָּל־יְמֵ֣י מְתוּשֶׁ֔לַח תֵּ֤שַׁע וְשִׁשִּׁים֙ שָׁנָ֔ה וּתְשַׁ֥ע מֵא֖וֹת שָׁנָ֑ה וַיָּמֹֽת׃פ

controles.web: All the days of Methuselah were nine hundred sixty-nine years, then he died.
controles.kjv: And all the days of Methuselah were nine hundred sixty and nine years: and he died.
controles.livre: Foram, pois, todos os dias de Matusalém, novecentos e sessenta e nove anos; e morreu.

versos.hebraico: וַֽיְחִי־לֶ֕מֶךְ שְׁתַּ֧יִם וּשְׁמֹנִ֛ים שָׁנָ֖ה וּמְאַ֣ת שָׁנָ֑ה וַיּ֖וֹלֶד בֵּֽן׃

controles.web: Lamech lived one hundred eighty-two years, then became the father of a son.
controles.kjv: And Lamech lived an hundred eighty and two years, and begat a son:
controles.livre: E viveu Lameque cento e oitenta e dois anos, e gerou um filho:

versos.hebraico: וַיִּקְרָ֧א אֶת־שְׁמ֛וֹ נֹ֖חַ לֵאמֹ֑ר זֶ֞֠ה יְנַחֲמֵ֤נוּ מִֽמַּעֲשֵׂ֨נוּ֙ וּמֵעִצְּב֣וֹן יָדֵ֔ינוּ מִן־הָ֣אֲדָמָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר אֵֽרְרָ֖הּ יְהוָֽה׃

controles.web: He named him Noah, saying, “This one will comfort us in our work and in the toil of our hands, caused by the ground which Yahweh has cursed.”
controles.kjv: And he called his name Noah, saying, This same shall comfort us concerning our work and toil of our hands, because of the ground which the Lord hath cursed.
controles.livre: E chamou seu nome Noé, dizendo: Este nos aliviará de nossas obras, e do trabalho de nossas mãos, por causa da terra que o SENHOR amaldiçoou.

versos.hebraico: וַֽיְחִי־לֶ֗מֶךְ אַֽחֲרֵי֙ הוֹלִיד֣וֹ אֶת־נֹ֔חַ חָמֵ֤שׁ וְתִשְׁעִים֙ שָׁנָ֔ה וַחֲמֵ֥שׁ מֵאֹ֖ת שָׁנָ֑ה וַיּ֥וֹלֶד בָּנִ֖ים וּבָנֽוֹת׃

controles.web: Lamech lived after he became the father of Noah five hundred ninety-five years, and became the father of other sons and daughters.
controles.kjv: And Lamech lived after he begat Noah five hundred ninety and five years, and begat sons and daughters:
controles.livre: E viveu Lameque, depois que gerou a Noé, quinhentos noventa e cinco anos: e gerou filhos e filhas.

versos.hebraico: וַֽיְהִי֙ כָּל־יְמֵי־לֶ֔מֶךְ שֶׁ֤בַע וְשִׁבְעִים֙ שָׁנָ֔ה וּשְׁבַ֥ע מֵא֖וֹת שָׁנָ֑ה וַיָּמֹֽת׃ס

controles.web: All the days of Lamech were seven hundred seventy-seven years, then he died.
controles.kjv: And all the days of Lamech were seven hundred seventy and seven years: and he died.
controles.livre: E foram todos os dias de Lameque setecentos e setenta e sete anos; e morreu.

versos.hebraico: וַֽיְהִי־נֹ֕חַ בֶּן־חֲמֵ֥שׁ מֵא֖וֹת שָׁנָ֑ה וַיּ֣וֹלֶד נֹ֔חַ אֶת־שֵׁ֖ם אֶת־חָ֥ם וְאֶת־יָֽפֶת׃

controles.web: Noah was five hundred years old, then Noah became the father of Shem, Ham, and Japheth.
controles.kjv: And Noah was five hundred years old: and Noah begat Shem, Ham, and Japheth.
controles.livre: E sendo Noé de quinhentos anos, gerou a Sem, Cam, e a Jafé.
